rationale: BLOCKED. I read the complete held EO 8380 (5 FR 1115, March 19, 1940; the held extract also carries the end of EO 8379 and unrelated quarantine notices): sec. 1 renames the Cold Springs Reservation (Umatilla County, Oregon; created by EO 1032, enlarged by EO 1439) the Cold Springs National Wildlife Refuge; sec. 2 adds 80 acres; sec. 3 describes the refuge as 2,756.83 acres; sec. 4 preserves reclamation use; sec. 5 supersedes EO 6910's temporary withdrawal as to the added lands. It has no sunset and no savings clause. The history shows the catalog note 'Amends EO 1032, 1439, 6910; See: Public Land Order 1083, March 4, 1955 (20 FR 1439)' and a 1989 Codification row classified 'Public lands' and 'excluded_not_ended', i.e. the 1989 table lists it as not ended. The 1955 PLO is a cross-reference only, whose content I cannot read, and the refuge may well still exist (a YES would need a held current predicate, which is absent). The order partly merges into later land-management instruments, so I decline to guess either status.
